description: Land Acquisition - Purijjala, Ukuwela D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition for a public purpose (road widening and improvement). It contains detailed descriptions of specific land lots being acquired, including lot numbers, claimants, original claimants, and land extents. This falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4, specifically covering land acquisitions. The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
